safety_review.native_harness: Unique HOME/runtime/config/data/cache and private session bus with no activation service directories; virtual KWin, private client windows and cleanup scoped to owned PIDs.
safety_review.adapt_fixture: Private PATH allowlist with stubbed systemctl/sysctl/loginctl/rpm-ostree plus private root/sys/proc.
safety_review.device_tests: Production hardware reads only; firmware test subprocess calls mocked.
safety_review.remote_startup: New native test uses its own ephemeral loopback listener and temporary endpoint; no PIN, portal, owner listener or actual authentication policy is accessed. Production catches only IOException with nested AddressAlreadyInUse SocketException, returns 75 before endpoint/listening publication, and disposes WebApplication plus existing input/capture bridges on scope exit. Existing systemd retry limits are unchanged.

limits: Native Arrange proof exercises skipSwitcher exclusion for centre plus old/fixed and eligible positive. Wider exclusions/actions are exercised in private Node callbacks, not all native KWin permutations.
No physical hardware, suspend, hotplug or new signed delivery is established by review.
The independent review did not execute the .NET suite; the assigned implementer owns native Kestrel test execution. Final ARM image must verify actual enumerator paths and binary providers.
